pending.limitation: Semantic C++ provider compiles16 bytes versus full R5 function40; excluded. Its getter and complete backing storage are independently certified through an explicit seed. The model initializer and its patching callees remain unimplemented and excluded.

review.scope: Prior complete closure plus six object/pickup pool methods and destroy_pickup descriptor.
review.typed_data: SCRIPT_COMMAND is packed WORD plus char[16], 18 bytes. Globals are full DWORD/pointer/WORD zero objects. No code subsection is truncated.
review.identities: Actor, entity, pool and script identities checked against R5 call sites, vtables, native offsets and command descriptors. CRT calls checked against their call signatures and pinned entry ranges.
review.pending: Six implemented providers remain excluded: AddEntry, PushBack, SetMatrixAndUpdate, FUNC_1009EC80, GetEulerAngles, and ANSI GetColorFromEmbedCode (257 source bytes vs 271 original code bytes). The wide-character color parser matches independently; RemoveColorEmbedsFromString only counts its own body.
review.assembly: Actor Destroy/FlushPedIntelligence, Entity TeleportTo, ExecuteScriptBuf and the three GTA pool/world bridges are explicitly labeled symbolic assembly. No byte emission. Expanded Entity: ApplyTurnSpeed, GetDistanceFromCentreOfMassToBaseOfModel, GetBoundCentre, GetBoundRect, SetApplySpeed and SetClumpAlpha retain symbolic upstream assembly, individually labeled. Absolute GTA call targets remain exact unmasked operands. Entity tail ApplyForce, PlayAudio, DeleteRwObject and ProcessControl use explicitly labeled symbolic native ABI bridges. No byte emission or address masking. New utility/game functions containing upstream symbolic assembly are individually labeled from their complete source definitions; no instruction byte emission. Four raster helpers retain their labeled upstream symbolic assembly; player-record routines are ordinary C++.
review.new_actor: Packed payload WORD@0, skin@2, x/y/z@6/A/E, rotation@12, health@16, immune@1A. R5 calls ActorPed ctor, SetHealth, ToggleImmunity and UpdateCount. New EH cleanup frees allocation through CRT delete; FuncInfo at F763C references unwind map F7634 and cleanup DFEA0.
review.new_entity: Full direct-byte identities and complete R5 function boundaries confirm bridges and flag operations. Geometry calls shared GetMatrix/SetMatrix/SetMoveSpeedVector. Constants are full float objects: 100000 (47C35000), .04 (3D23D70A), PI/180 (3C8EFA35), and zero. Inline x87 instructions implement sqrt/sin/cos; no new CRT dependencies.
review.entity_tail: ApplyForce forwards six floats to GTA 542A50; PlayAudio forwards event and zero to 4F6420 on native entity+138. DeleteRwObject and ProcessControl call native vtable slots 20 and 28. GetRwObject reads native+18; IsNativeTarget compares the native pointer with B7CD68 and returns BYTE in AL. IsStationary tests world membership and exact zero velocity. AdvancePosition uses timestep B7CB5C, GetMatrix, then SetMatrixAndUpdate.
review.generated_symbols: Header additions renumbered compiler-local EH labels. Previous region hashes and fixup offset/type/reference targets are unchanged and checked; new local symbol identities are recorded here.
review.common_utilities: Pool accessors and native task bridges have unique full-body identities including fixed GTA addresses, calling conventions and pointer offsets. Pure C++ numeric, vehicle subtype, hex/color, time/weather and streaming routines match complete R5 functions. Native engine implementations remain external to coverage.
review.commands: Fourteen additional SCRIPT_COMMAND objects are each compared as packed WORD opcode + char[16] signature (18 bytes), including marker, interior, weather/time-related and streaming operations.
review.weapon_switch: GameGetWeaponModelIDFromWeaponID: RVA B3E20, complete source COMDAT 556 bytes, including 371 code bytes plus alignment and all 46 relocated switch entries. CGame wrapper at A03D0 forwards to this reviewed identity; table bytes are not code coverage.
review.new_crt: R5 __stat, _wcsncpy and _strstr have matching pinned inventory identities. wcstoul at CAF61 is the 23-byte wrapper forwarding its three arguments and unsigned-mode flag 1 to CAD6B; actual linked provider is the CRT wcstoul symbol. CRT bodies remain excluded.
review.new_import: VirtualProtect is pinned to kernel32.dll in both PE import tables, with the original stdcall signature and stack restoration in UnFuck.
review.player_records: PLAYER_PED_SLOTS is 210 and struc_13 contains four DWORD fields. The complete pointer array is 840 bytes at 26BF10, and the complete record array is 3360 bytes at 26C258. R5 Init clears 210 and 840 DWORDs respectively. Record operations use strides 4 and 16 and the guarded operations reject BYTE indices >=210. GetPlayerPedPtrRecord is anchored at B4350 by its table target and adjacent record operations.
review.storage: Each new global is defined as a complete independent C++ object, with a compile-time sizeof assertion and original declaration provenance. The resulting complete BSS sections are verified by the unchanged gate, without data slicing, padding templates or changes to acceptance rules. Their zero contents are excluded from code coverage.
review.rasters: Four full native bridge bodies at B5AD0/B5B50/B5BC0/B5C90 reference reviewed frame-buffer, image and dimension globals. Width/Height/Depth are native int32, other scalars are DWORD. GTA RenderWare call operands and the three filename/format strings plus No texture literal remain exact. AddDebugMessage and WriteRwRasterToFile targets are actual source providers. Native rendering and bitmap file I/O are not executed by this static acceptance.
review.game_init: CGame constructor at 9FF80 performs original CRT allocations of 5 and 8 bytes for packed CAudio and CCamera. Header constructors at 9FF70/9FF60 initialize audio state and the camera matrix pointer B6F99C. The complete bUsedPlayerSlots[210] object occupies 840 bytes and is cleared by the constructor. FindFirstFreePlayerPedSlot and FUNC_100A00F0 traverse slots 2..209 and compare each BOOL with exactly TRUE (1), preserving the distinction from other nonzero values.
review.verification: Actual class methods match the isolated experiment. All six complete function ranges, original/linked relocations and complete18-byte destroy_pickup descriptor are verified. Shared header edits required recompiling their consumers once under the existing Ob1/Ob2 profiles. Existing gate mutations and ABI exercise only; no extra runtime test or redundant build.
review.model: SetModelIndex uses the actual packed R5 CEntity at offset40, retains source-derived native virtual calls and adds R5 signed >200 polling, helper, BOOL return and warning. All 15 fixups independently checked against the reference evaluation and existing identities. ModelInfoLoaded is a complete 16-byte compiled semantic provider bound to B45A0 but unmatched; neither it nor transitive code/storage contributes coverage.
review.camera_audio: Script descriptors reviewed as complete opcode+16 argument-character objects; source descriptors and referenced R5 objects equal byte for byte. All script calls bind to accepted ScriptCommand B2310. Camera matrix members use the existing 8-byte layout. Source symbolic GTA calls remain labeled. Position limits are the complete float constants +20000,-20000,+100000,-10000 at reviewed addresses. Float data and descriptors are not counted as source code coverage.
review.vehicle: The three 0.2.5 turret methods use the existing packed CVehicle native pointer at 4C and native tank rotation floats at 94C/950. Remaining methods are whole definitions from the existing R5 import. Full function boundaries and every pool, subtype, model-index and script target reviewed against established identities. HasSunk uses opcode02BF at ED574; IsWrecked uses opcode0119 at ED588, so superficially identical wrapper shapes cannot be swapped. No constructor/destructor, constant-return GetPassengersMax, or unverified 0.2.5 wheel-damage signature is accepted.
review.player: SetAmmo, IsOnGround and SetWeaponModelIndex transferred from pinned 0.2.5 using actual packed CPlayerPed. Other selected methods are full existing R5 source definitions. Native inline assembly is labeled per source body. GetTargetRotation uses the same higher-precision float PI as the already matched utilities to produce the complete 57.2957763671875 constant at E6128.
review.dependencies: All helper function identities and source signatures reviewed. Key table 210*308 bytes, aim table 210*48 bytes and weapon skill table 210*11*4 bytes are complete source arrays, including final entries. Local skill array contains exactly 11 floats. Current-player, key-state and stats pointers retain their native GTA values B7CD74/B73458/B79380. Full 4*16-byte dance tables are verified, as are complete 32-byte shop-name and 4-byte task globals. Initialized storage translation units use minimal headers to avoid unrelated RakNet objects; no data sections are sliced.
review.shared_controls: All native pointers retain their reviewed GTA values; complete 210-entry camera-mode/zoom/aspect arrays and local aim/key objects preserve source extents. Drive-by saved flags are separate one-byte zero objects. 35.0/1.0/reciprocal35 constants are complete source-generated floats. No previously covered bytes are counted twice.
review.tasks: CTask is a 16-byte polymorphic wrapper with ownership BOOL at4, player pointer8 and native task pointerC. Native calls and their argument order come from the existing task.cpp symbolic assembly. All six seven-slot vtables bind reviewed scalar deleting destructors and the six common virtual operations. Jetpack destructor clears the player native task link then destroys the task; its complete 8-byte unwind-map entry, 28-byte FuncInfo, 8-byte unwind thunk and 10-byte EH entry are verified without slicing. The default constructor deliberately leaves the ownership flag uninitialized, as the source and original do.
review.render: RenderWare native call selection uses the complete iGtaVersion scalar at26EB28. Font tail calls and texture wrappers retain source-derived native argument handling. Full native addresses and version branches match without relocations being hidden. RwFrameRotate axis data occupies the complete52-byte source COFF section:36 bytes of three axes followed by the actual emitted RakNet unassigned IDs and padding, all equal to the R5 section fragment.
review.menus: Menu label storage is a complete12*2*33-byte source array at FE0C8. All six script descriptors, DUMMY/SAMPHED/SAMPRW1/SAMPRW2 labels and compiler float-to-integer helper are separately identified. The older 0.2.5 menu algorithm was consulted and is already present in this R5 base; no additional direct-transfer credit is claimed.
review.radar: All1000 source palette DWORDs and the complete4000-byte mutable color array match. Existing sizeof-based bounds and missing-return behavior are preserved, not repaired. Palette and object data contribute no code bytes.
review.ui_pools: Menu pool keeps128 menu pointers,128 BOOL slot states and the current-menu sentinel128. GetTextPointer binds the already certified complete label table and actual CMenu accessors. Menu-pool New and Process are not selected or counted. Gang-zone pool retains1024 slots and24-byte allocated zone records, including the original MinX/MaxY/MaxX/MinY coordinate order, malloc/delete behavior and unchecked indices. Draw retains the500ms signed tick delta and bitwise-inverted byte phase; its one-byte phase and four-byte last tick are separate complete source static objects.
review.model_storage: R5 initializer A7A00 full52 bytes independently reviewed: clears65535 DWORDs from1625B0, copies20000 native pointers from A9B0C8 through114B08, then calls A7970/A6FF0. Initial slot114B08 points to1825AC, exactly32767 elements into the full array. Mode flag1A25AC follows the array. Getter preserves signed lower bound0 and inclusive upper bound20000 in native mode, and unbounded signed indexing in extended mode. All three source objects occupy complete isolated COFF sections; the pointer addend131068 is verified against both original and linked targets. ModelInfoLoaded and initialization/patching routines are not counted. These additions derive from R5 evidence, not direct0.2.5 transfer.
review.object_pickup: Four missing methods transferred from michael-fa0.2.5, then adapted to R5: object lookup uses inclusive last-object-ID and invalid65535, pickup Destroy also resets the network-ID slot. Original full R5 accesses independently establish last-object-ID at0, object slots at4 and pointers atFA4, native entity at40; pickup count at0, handles4, network IDs4004, timers8004 and packed3-byte dropped recordsC004. Existing layouts are retained, replacing the opaque dropped-record gap with its complete typed array. CObject remains incomplete and is never instantiated; lookup accesses only its verified CEntity base. Object constructor34 and pickup destructor45 already existed in the R5 base and receive no direct0.2.5 transfer credit. New/Delete/Process and other absent object/pickup methods remain outside this closure.
